QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: diskLoggingEnabled
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Write application log messages to disk in Logs directory.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Enable

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: diskLoggingMaxFileSizeMB
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Maximum size of a single log file in megabytes before rotation.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Max File Size (MB)

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: diskLoggingMaxBackupFiles
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Number of rotated backup log files to keep.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Max Backup Files

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: saveFormat
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: File format used when saving the application log.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Save Format

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: remoteLoggingEnabled
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Stream this application's log to an observability endpoint so support can diagnose issues remotely.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Logs ship only while this is on. The endpoint and token are stored on this machine; nothing is sent anywhere else.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Enable

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: remoteLoggingEndpoint
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: OTLP endpoint (host:port) the log is shipped to.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Aircast's collector is filled in. A bare host:port is treated as HTTPS, except on the plaintext OTLP ports 4317 and 4318.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: OTLP endpoint

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: remoteLoggingToken
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Support issues this. It is sent as an Authorization header and stored on this machine only.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Bearer token
